cards.text: It's the Feast of Tabernacles, and Jesus has been teaching in the temple courts (John 7:14). Once again He tells the people, "I am the light of the world." Friend, after YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, when somebody says light, I'm LISTENING.

cards.question: Jesus says He is the light of the world. What does He promise whoever follows Him?

answers.text: They will never walk in the darkness
They will never be hungry again
They will never be troubled again

cards.text: Then the Pharisees, a group of strict religious leaders, push back. They say His words don't hold up, and they've got their reason READY, like they rehearsed it in the car on the way over.

cards.question: What's the Pharisees' complaint about what Jesus just said?

answers.text: He is teaching on the Sabbath
He never studied with a teacher

cards.question: Jesus agrees with the Pharisees that His testimony about Himself is not valid.

cards.text: Jesus says His testimony IS valid, because He knows where He came from and where He's going, but they don't know either one. Friend, I've walked into my own storeroom and forgotten why I came in.
Then Jesus tells them they judge according to the flesh, and as for Him, He judges no one. Me? I judge every batch that comes out of my oven, and I have NEVER once ruled in my own favor.

cards.question: Jesus says that even if He does judge, His judgment is true, because He is not ___.

cards.text: Now Jesus goes right to their own Law. Friend, nothing ends an argument faster than somebody reading your OWN group chat back to you.

cards.question: Their Law says the testimony of ___ men is valid. Jesus has that many: Himself and the ___.
The Pharisees ask, "Where is Your Father?" Jesus answers that if they knew Him, they would know His Father as well.

cards.text: Jesus says all this while teaching in the temple courts, near the treasury, right out in the open, and nobody lays a hand on Him. Me? I was HIDING in the back of a junk drawer, and I still got grabbed every time somebody needed scissors.

cards.question: Jesus is teaching right out in the open. Why does no one seize Him?

answers.text: His hour had not yet come
The guards are afraid of Him

cards.text: Again Jesus tells them He's going away, and they'll look for Him, but they will die in their sin. That is NOT small talk, friend.

cards.question: Jesus tells them they will be able to come where He is going.

cards.text: That line leaves the Jews with questions, and they start trying to work out where He could possibly be going. It's my face reading a cookie recipe that just says "bake until done," like, done WHEN?!

cards.question: Jesus said, "Where I am going, you cannot come." What do the Jews wonder?

answers.text: Whether He is going back to Galilee
Whether He will go teach the Greeks

cards.text: Jesus answers by telling them where everybody's from: "You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world." Me? I'm from the bottom of a clearance bin, priced at 25 cents.

cards.question: Jesus warns them they will die in their sins unless they ___ that He is the One.
The Jews ask Jesus, "Who are You?" What does He answer?

answers.text: Just what He's told them from the beginning
A prophet like Moses sent to Israel
The son of Joseph from Nazareth

cards.text: Jesus says He has much to say about them and much to judge, but the One who sent Him is truthful, and what Jesus has heard from Him, He tells the world. Friend, I can't pass a message across my own bakery without it coming out WRONG by the end.

cards.question: When Jesus talks about the One who sent Him, the crowd doesn't understand who He means. Who is He telling them about?

cards.text: They missed who He meant, and no judgment here, friend: when somebody texts me "he called," I spend TWENTY MINUTES guessing WHICH he. So Jesus tells them that once they have lifted up the Son of Man, then they will know that He is the One.

cards.question: Once they've lifted up the Son of Man, Jesus says they'll know He does nothing on His own, but speaks exactly what the ___ has taught Him.

cards.text: Jesus says the One who sent Him is with Him and has not left Him alone. After my years in that drawer, friend, that line hits me right in the apron.

cards.question: Jesus says the Father has not left Him alone, because He always does what pleases Him.
Jesus keeps speaking about the Father who sent Him. As He speaks these things, what do many do?

cards.text: And that's where we pull this batch out of the oven, friend. But keep that apron ON, because this conversation is NOT finished.
